{"reason": "Failure rows are all truth=demand-forecast-error mislabeled unknown: (a) market-mismatch=#t with no bias flag (7 rows, amounts up to 254000) — the unused market-signal-mismatch? helper captures these; (b) forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 below the 0.1 cutoff. So the forecast branch now fires on market mismatch OR bias, with the threshold lowered to 0.05.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
